config.title: Pathfinding Config
config.text:
This is relevant for the treasure hunting and carrot hunting functionality.
Note that costs are compared to the total distance of a path in yalms.

return_cost.label: Return Cost
return_cost.tooltip: The assigned cost of casting return and approaching the Aetheryte.

teleport_cost.label: Teleport Cost
teleport_cost.tooltip: The assigned cost of casting teleport from on Aetheryte to another.

detection_range.label: Object Detection Range
detection_range.tooltip:
The distance from a node you have to be to assume it isn't there.
This may vary depending on when the server sends the GameObject instance.
A lower value will be more reliable but will make the hunt take longer.

max_level.label: Max area level
max_level.tooltip: The maximum level of mobs near which you are willing to hunt for objects.

avoid_aggro.label: Avoid aggro when pathing
avoid_aggro.tooltip:
Bend automated routes around hostile mobs instead of walking through them.
Routes shorter than 40 yalms are left alone - those are approaches, not journeys.

yield_to_manual_control.label: Yield to manual control
yield_to_manual_control.tooltip:
Pause automation while you are steering, then recompute the route from where you actually are
rather than dragging you back to the point you walked away from.
